name: Haopterus
isnote: Grouped with Mimodactylus in Mimodactylidae within Istiodactyliformes (Kellner et al. 2019), but a 2024 redescription recovered it as a primitive ornithocheiriform.
sum: Small crestless pteranodontoid from the Yixian Formation of Liaoning — the first Chinese pterosaur found with a skull.
holotype: IVPP V11726 — Yixian Formation, Sihetun, Liaoning (found 1998).
material: Front half of a subadult: skull (145 mm), lower jaws, girdle, sternum, wings, vertebrae, partial pelvis.
biology: Twelve pairs of robust, recurved teeth; probably took fish and other small prey.
author: Wang and Lü 2001
